heroSummary: The Bambu Lab P1P handles eSUN PLA+ exceptionally well out of the box with its open frame and stock stainless steel nozzle. Leveraging a maximum volumetric flow rate of 22 mm³/s, it reliably reaches print speeds up to 262 mm/s without requiring hardware upgrades.
bedSurfaceRecommendation: Textured PEI Plate (clean with warm water and dish soap, no adhesive required)
slicerTweaks: Set Max Volumetric Speed to 22 mm³/s in the filament settings to automatically cap linear speeds at 262 mm/s on 0.2mm standard profiles.
Enable Pressure Advance and calibrate K-factor (typical value 0.020 - 0.026 for eSUN PLA+ on the stock direct drive extruder).
Set Nozzle Temperature to 220°C for high-speed infill/inner walls and 215°C for outer perimeters to maximize layer adhesion while maintaining surface finish.
Adjust Auxiliary Fan speed to 0-30% or disable it completely to prevent differential cooling warping on long prints in the open-frame P1P.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Corner lifting or edge warping on large flat prints
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Localized drafts on the open-frame P1P or excessive auxiliary part cooling blowing unevenly across the build plate.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Turn off the auxiliary cooling fan in the cooling tab and increase the bed temperature from 60°C to 65°C for the first 3 layers.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Matte finish and weak layer bonding at high speeds
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Extrusion temperature dropping below optimal melting zone temperature when exceeding 200 mm/s.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Increase nozzle temperature by 5-10°C (up to 225°C) and reduce outer wall speed to 150 mm/s for a glossy, uniform finish.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Fine stringing across open travel moves
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Slight filament moisture uptake or sub-optimal wipe distance on low-viscosity PLA+.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Set Retraction Distance to 0.8 mm, enable 'Wipe while retracting' with a 1.5 mm wipe distance, and dry spool at 45°C for 4 hours if stringing persists.

faq.question: Do I need to enclose the Bambu Lab P1P to print eSUN PLA+ reliably?
faq.answer: No, an enclosure is not required and can actually cause heat creep with PLA+. The P1P's open-frame architecture provides optimal ambient ventilation for rapid cooling.

faq.question: Does eSUN PLA+ require a hardened steel nozzle upgrade on the P1P?
faq.answer: No, eSUN PLA+ is a non-abrasive polymer blend that runs completely safely on the P1P's stock stainless steel nozzle without causing premature wear.

faq.question: Why does my print look duller when printed at maximum speed compared to standard PLA?
faq.answer: High-speed extrusion reduces the filament's melt residence time, scattering light differently. Increasing the hotend temperature to 220-225°C restores gloss and maximizes layer adhesion.

faq.question: Should I use glue stick on the Bambu Textured PEI plate for eSUN PLA+?
faq.answer: No, glue stick is unnecessary. Clean the Textured PEI plate with hot water and plain dish soap; PLA+ will adhere firmly at 60°C and pop off effortlessly when cooled below 35°C.
